title: host.selfcheck.perf
description: Runs a performance gate (02 §8.3) and reports measured numbers against the budget. gate=idle: per-frame host cost with this client connected and idle (budget < 0.1 ms) plus the last idle-probe result; gate=screenshot: N captures at 1024 px measuring main-thread ms (budget <= 3 ms async readback, <= 30 ms fallback) and Texture2D/RenderTexture counts before/after; gate=log: a synthetic log of `vessels` targets x 3 fields at 10 Hz measuring sampler ms per FixedUpdate (budget <= 0.2 ms). Long-running: returns an op.

captures.description: number of captures for the screenshot gate (100 for the leak check)

vessels.description: log gate: number of vessel targets to sample (loaded vessels are repeated to reach it)
